title: Fema / RBI | RBI FAQs on All you wanted to know about NBFCs | 11 November 2026 Update
description: The issue concerns regulatory burden on smaller NBFCs without systemic risk exposure. The RBI introduced exemption for such entities under “Unregistered Type I NBFCs.” The key takeaway is that low-risk NBFCs may operate without registration subject to strict conditions.The post RBI FAQs on All you wanted to know about NBFCs | 11 November 2026 Update appeared first on TaxGuru.
